title: Workload Classification
description: Deterministic output contract for classifying a user's deployment request into structured workload parameters. This is the first stage of the deployment architect pipeline.

workload_type.description: Primary workload category derived from user intent

framework.description: Serving/training framework that determines the container image and cmd pattern

id.description: HuggingFace model ID or exact model name (e.g., 'mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2')

parameter_count_billions.description: Model size in billions of parameters (e.g., 7, 14, 32, 70)

nosana_cdn_available.description: Whether pre-staged weights exist on models.nosana.io

nosana_cdn_url.description: S3 URL on models.nosana.io if available

quantization.description: Model quantization level — directly determines VRAM calculation

gpu_required.description: Whether gpu:true must be set in the job definition

enabled.description: Whether the workload exposes a network port via FRP

port.description: Primary port the service listens on

requires_zero_bind.description: Whether the service MUST bind to 0.0.0.0 (almost always true for exposed services)

private_url.description: Whether to use random URL generation instead of deterministic hash

volumes_required.description: Whether named volumes are needed for data persistence

model_prefetch_required.description: Whether S3 resource pre-fetching is needed for model weights

secrets.description: Nosana secrets required at runtime (array syntax in env)

deployment_type.description: How this workload should be deployed — determines CLI vs deployment-manager path

confidential.description: Whether the job definition contains sensitive data requiring P2P encryption
